_comment: THE SINGLE SOURCE FOR WHAT THE MEMBERS LIBRARY CONTAINS, keyed by language. Added Aug 13, 2026 after finding that all three All-Access sales pages described the members area as 'flexibility, kettlebell, fixing lower back pain' — one deleted that same day, two that never existed — while naming none of the eight real entries. The pages had been hand-written, so they decayed silently every time the library changed. Rendered by _includes/partials/library-showcase.njk. WHEN A TOOL SHIPS OR RETIRES, EDIT THIS FILE AND NOTHING ELSE ON THE MARKETING SIDE. Inventory of record (URLs, engines, retirements) stays in triaperformance-business-overview.md §Interactive tools; this file is the customer-facing wording of the same list. The n8n emails deliberately do NOT name individual tools — they say 'the library, and I add new tools every week' and link to the members home, which is why they were the only surface that did not rot. Keep them that way. Each live entry also carries `key` (stable id used by partials/tool-cta.njk from an article's `toolCta` front matter), `url` (where a PUBLIC reader should land — the public calculator for zones, the All-Access library anchor for everything gated, because sending article traffic at a login wall converts nothing) and `gated`. RULE: an entry belongs in 'live' only when the page exists in THAT language; anything else goes in 'soon'. Checked against site/members/ on every hygiene pass (cyclistcore Aug 24, strength Sep 2 were both sold before they existed).

es.heading: La biblioteca del Área de Miembros
es.intro: Herramientas interactivas que te armás en el momento, no PDFs para archivar. Todo está adentro de la suscripción, en español, inglés y portugués.
es.soonIntro: Sumo herramientas nuevas todas las semanas. Esto es lo que sigue en la lista:

live.name: Calculadora de Zonas
live.desc: Metés el resultado de tu test y salen tus siete zonas de ritmo, pulso y potencia en los tres deportes. Con el registro de tests para saber cuándo toca volver a medir.

live.name: Activación
live.desc: Respondés tres preguntas — deporte, cómo llegás, si tenés minibanda — y el circuito se arma solo. Del suelo a estar de pie, con timer por ejercicio.

live.name: Rodillas Sin Dolor
live.desc: Fuerza para blindar la rodilla: glúteo medio, vasto interno y cadena posterior. Elegís casa o gimnasio, con contador de series y descanso.

live.name: Aquiles Sin Dolor
live.desc: Carga progresiva para tendinopatía de aquiles, según dónde te duele exactamente. Con las reglas para saber cada día si te pasaste.

live.name: Hombro de Nadador
live.desc: El hombro que se pincha al salir del agua. Liberación, movilidad y fuerza para los rotadores externos y el omóplato. Con o sin banda, en casa o en el gimnasio.

live.name: Core Sin Excusas
live.desc: Activación, core y movilidad en una sola rutina cronometrada. Sin equipo y sin más espacio que el largo de tu cuerpo — para viajes y semanas complicadas.

live.name: Core de Ciclista
live.desc: Core anti-rotación, anti-extensión y anti-flexión lateral: que la pelvis no se mueva mientras las piernas empujan. Tres o cuatro vueltas, sin equipo.

live.name: Respiración en Caja
live.desc: Temporizador guiado de 3, 5 o 10 minutos para bajar revoluciones después de una sesión fuerte o antes de dormir.

live.name: Configurar tu Garmin
live.desc: Tus siete zonas en los cinco campos del reloj, por deporte, y cómo conviven TrainingPeaks y Garmin sin contradecirse.

live.name: Carga de Entrenamiento
live.desc: TSS, CTL, ATL, TSB y el gráfico PMC explicados una vez y bien, con capturas reales de TrainingPeaks.

live.name: Hipertrofia, Fuerza y Potencia
live.desc: Tres adaptaciones, tres protocolos, y cómo ordenarlas en el año — con un bloque para rendimiento y otro para quien quiere masa muscular.

live.name: Guías en PDF
live.desc: Sesiones por zona, nutrición y preparación mental — para descargar cuando quieras.

soon.name: Ejecución de carrera y pacing
soon.desc: Plan de carrera por distancia, del 5k al Ironman.

soon.name: Nutrición y carga de carbohidratos
soon.desc: Tu esquema de hidratos por sesión y la semana de carrera.

soon.name: Rutina de espalda baja
soon.desc: Para la lumbar que se queja después del sillín o del fondo.

soon.name: Más herramientas de preparación mental
soon.desc: Rutinas para la semana previa y para los momentos malos de la carrera.

en.heading: The Members Area library
en.intro: Interactive tools you build in the moment, not PDFs to file away. All of it is inside the subscription, in English, Spanish and Portuguese.
en.soonIntro: I add new tools every week. This is what's next on the list:

live.name: Training Zones Calculator
live.desc: Put in your test result and out come your seven pace, heart rate and power zones across all three sports. With the testing log that tells you when to retest.

live.name: Activation
live.desc: Answer three questions — sport, how you're arriving, whether you have a mini-band — and the circuit builds itself. Floor to standing, timed per exercise.

live.name: Pain-Free Knees
live.desc: Strength to bulletproof the knee: glute medius, VMO and posterior chain. Pick home or gym, with a set counter and rest timer.

live.name: Pain-Free Achilles
live.desc: Progressive loading for Achilles tendinopathy, matched to exactly where it hurts. With the rules for knowing each day whether you overdid it.

live.name: Swimmer's Shoulder
live.desc: The shoulder that pinches as the arm leaves the water. Release, mobility and strength for the external rotators and the shoulder blade. With or without a band, at home or at the gym.

live.name: No-Excuses Core
live.desc: Activation, core and mobility in one timed routine. No equipment and no more space than your own body length — for travel and difficult weeks.

live.name: Cyclist Core
live.desc: Anti-rotation, anti-extension and anti-lateral-flexion work so the pelvis stays still while the legs push. Three or four rounds, no equipment.

live.name: Box Breathing
live.desc: A guided 3, 5 or 10 minute timer for bringing the system down after a hard session or before sleep.

live.name: Setting Up Your Garmin
live.desc: Your seven zones in the watch's five fields, per sport, and how TrainingPeaks and Garmin coexist without contradicting each other.

live.name: Training Load Explained
live.desc: TSS, CTL, ATL, TSB and the PMC chart explained once and properly, with real TrainingPeaks screenshots.

live.name: Hypertrophy, Strength and Power
live.desc: Three adaptations, three protocols, and how to sequence them across a year — with one block for performance and another for athletes who want the muscle.

live.name: PDF guides
live.desc: Training zone sessions, plus nutrition and mental prep — downloadable whenever you want them.

soon.desc: Your carbohydrate targets per session and through race week.
